meta.title: Klever Tracker
meta.description: GPS fleet tracking for the UAE and GCC

validation.email: Enter a valid email address, like name@company.ae.
validation.resetLinkInvalid: This reset link is incomplete. Request a new one.
validation.nonNegative: Enter a number that's 0 or more.
validation.year: Enter a year between 1950 and next year.
validation.dayOfMonth: Enter a day of the month from 1 to 31.
validation.timeRange: The end time must be different from the start time.
validation.afterStart: This must be after the start.
validation.odometerBack: This reading is lower than the starting reading.
validation.future: Choose a time in the future.
validation.greaterThanMin: Must be higher than the minimum.
validation.duplicatePlate: Another vehicle already has this plate number.
validation.downPaymentMax: The down payment can’t be more than the total cost.
validation.afterInstall: This must be on or after the installation date.
validation.notFuture: This can’t be in the future.
validation.duplicateName: This name is already used. Choose a different one.
validation.phone: Enter a valid phone number, like +971 50 123 4567.
validation.expiryAfterIssue: The expiry date must be after the issue date.
validation.lowBelowHigh: The high limit must be above the low limit.
validation.duplicateTank: This vehicle already has a tank with this number.
validation.refillMax: The minimum refill can’t be more than the tank volume.
validation.vehicleOut: This vehicle is already allocated. Record its return first.
validation.percentMax: A percentage discount can’t be more than 100.
validation.discountMax: The discount can’t be more than the amount.
validation.daysRequired: Choose at least one working day.
validation.duplicateDay: This vehicle already has an entry for this date. Edit that one instead.
validation.distanceMismatch: The distance should equal the stop reading minus the start reading.
validation.duplicateVoltage: Another record already has this voltage.
validation.minPoints: Add at least two records, e.g. an empty and a full tank reading.

errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do this.

errors.gateway: The tracking server rejected the connection. Try again later, or contact support if it continues.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the tracking server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_input: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.reset_failed: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Reset links work once and expire after 60 minutes.

reset.invalidLink: This reset link is incomplete. Open the link from your email again, or request a new one.

map.noPoints: No tracking data found for the selected vehicle and time range.

common.label: Label

vm.title: Vehicle management
vm.description: Vehicles and everything attached to them: allocations, maintenance, sensors, groups, working hours, distance logs, share links and fuel calibration.

moduleHints.vehicles: The fleet list and each vehicle's full record, documents, sensors and fuel tanks.
moduleHints.allocations: Hand a vehicle to a driver or project, then record its return and charges.
moduleHints.maintenance: Garage visits with their bill's line items.
moduleHints.tempSensors: Temperature sensors per vehicle, with low and high limits.
moduleHints.groups: Groups and sub groups of vehicles, with the person in charge.
moduleHints.workingHours: Shifts with their days, hours and assigned vehicles.
moduleHints.distance: A day-wise odometer and distance log per vehicle.
moduleHints.liveLocation: Time-limited links that show one vehicle's live location.
moduleHints.fuelCalibration: Voltage-to-litres tables for fuel level sensors.
moduleHints.types: The dropdown lists: vehicle, maintenance and service types.

vehicles.title: Vehicle details
vehicles.description: Every vehicle in your fleet. Open one to edit its details, documents, sensors and fuel tanks.
vehicles.empty: No vehicles yet. Add your first vehicle.
vehicles.createdNext: Vehicle added. You can now add its documents, sensors and fuel tanks.
vehicles.complianceNote: Insurance, Mulkiya and permits are on the Documents tab. You can add as many as you need, each with its own expiry date.
vehicles.fuelNote: Tanks, volumes, calibration and minimum refill are on the Fuel tanks tab.

f.trackingDaysHint: Movement outside these days and hours raises a working-hours alert.

doc.empty: No documents yet. Add the Mulkiya, insurance and any permits.
doc.label: Name

allocations.title: Allocate & return
allocations.description: Hand a vehicle to a driver or a project, then record its return, condition and charges.
allocations.needVehicles: Add vehicles first, then allocate them here.

f.totalHint: Filled in from the charges above. You can change it.

maintenance.title: Maintenance
maintenance.description: Garage visits, services and repairs, with the bill's line items.
maintenance.needVehicles: Add vehicles first, then record their maintenance here.
maintenance.vehicleFixed: The vehicle can't be changed after saving.

tempSensors.title: Temp sensors
tempSensors.description: Temperature sensors for each vehicle, with the low and high limits that trigger alerts. Add as many as a vehicle has.
tempSensors.noVehicles: No vehicles yet. Add vehicles under Vehicle details first.
tempSensors.name: Sensor name

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups and sub groups of vehicles. A sub group is a group with a parent.
groups.deleteFail: Couldn't delete this group. Delete or move its sub groups first.
groups.name: Group name
groups.parentHint: Leave empty for a top-level group.

workingHours.title: Working hours
workingHours.description: Shifts with their working days and hours, and the vehicles they apply to.
workingHours.overnightHint: If the end time is earlier than the start, the shift runs overnight.
workingHours.name: Shift name

distance.title: Vehicle distance
distance.description: A day-wise log of each vehicle's start and stop odometer readings and distance travelled.
distance.needVehicles: Add vehicles first, then log their distance here.
distance.autoHint: Worked out from the readings. You can change it.
distance.fixedOnEdit: The vehicle and date can't be changed after saving.

liveLocation.title: Live location
liveLocation.description: Time-limited links that let someone outside your company see one vehicle's live location.
liveLocation.editHint: Only the expiry can be changed. To share a different vehicle, create a new link.
liveLocation.needVehicles: Add vehicles first, then share their location here.
liveLocation.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Copy it from the table.
liveLocation.revoked: Link deleted. It no longer works.

fuelCalibration.title: Fuel calibration
fuelCalibration.description: Tables that turn a fuel level sensor's voltage into litres. Link one to a vehicle's fuel tank.
fuelCalibration.deleteFail: Couldn't delete this calibration. Unlink it from any fuel tanks first.
fuelCalibration.name: Calibration name
fuelCalibration.noPoints: No records yet. Add at least an empty and a full reading.
fuelCalibration.pointsHint: Each record is a sensor voltage and the fuel in the tank at that voltage. In-between values are worked out from the nearest records.
fuelCalibration.warnVoltage: Some voltages are outside the min–max range.
fuelCalibration.warnCapacity: Some records have more fuel than the tank capacity.

types.title: Types
types.description: The options in the type dropdowns. A type that's already used can't be deleted. Mark it Inactive to hide it from new records.
types.inactiveHint: Inactive types stay on existing records but aren't offered for new ones.
types.inUse: Couldn't delete this type. It's probably used by existing records. Mark it Inactive instead.

track.title: Live vehicle location
track.invalid: This link is invalid, has expired, or isn’t active yet. Ask the person who shared it for a new link.
track.unavailable: We couldn’t reach the tracking service. Try again in a few minutes.
track.noPosition: This vehicle hasn’t sent its location yet. This page updates by itself as soon as it does.
track.refreshFailed: Couldn’t refresh the location. Trying again shortly.
